privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.title: 1. General information
sections.body: Aqar Exit operates an online real estate platform specialized in installment property resales and contract assignments (exit deals) in Georgia at original contract prices with zero overprice. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data and property documents we collect from sellers and buyers, how we use them, and how we protect them in accordance with Georgian data protection laws.

sections.title: 2. What data we collect
sections.body: We collect information you voluntarily provide when registering an account, listing a unit for sale, submitting a buy request, or making an official offer. This includes: full name, phone number (and preferred messengers such as WhatsApp, Viber, Telegram), email address, property details (project name, developer, district, area size, contract price, paid amount, and remaining installments), as well as technical data such as IP address, browser type, and device information.

sections.title: 3. How data is used
sections.body: Collected data is used to operate the platform, match serious buyers with suitable exit units through our Smart Property Radar, communicate regarding listing statuses and purchase offers, send verification codes (OTP) and notifications, and improve platform security and performance. We never sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.title: 4. Data sharing and contact protection
sections.body: To protect owner privacy and prevent spam or unauthorized solicitation, Aqar Exit does not publicly display the seller’s phone number, email address, or exact unit number on public listing pages; only property specifications and financial figures are shown publicly. Contact details and assignment procedures are coordinated strictly through our verification team when a serious, verified purchase offer is submitted, in cooperation with the developer and the National Agency of Public Registry (NAPR). We may use trusted infrastructure providers (cloud hosting, databases, and consented analytics tools) under strict confidentiality obligations.

sections.title: 5. Cookies and local storage
sections.body: We use essential cookies and browser localStorage to maintain your login session, store your language preference, and save your favorite units. Only with your explicit consent, we also use analytics and ad measurement tools (Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and PostHog) to measure traffic and ad performance. None of these tracking scripts load before you grant consent, and you can change your choice anytime using the button at the bottom of this page.

sections.title: 6. Property documents and verification
sections.body: When sellers upload ownership and payment verification documents (developer contract, payment receipts, account statement, or passport/ID), these files are stored in encrypted cloud storage with restricted access. They are reviewed exclusively by our verification specialists to validate financial figures and grant the "Verified Documents" badge, and are never accessible to public visitors.

sections.title: 7. Storage and protection
sections.body: All data transmission is encrypted via HTTPS / TLS. Passwords are encrypted using Scrypt hashing with cryptographically signed session tokens, and sensitive owner fields are filtered on the server before reaching the client browser. Data is retained while your account remains active; if you request account deletion, your active listings are immediately paused and removed from public view.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
sections.body: Under the Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection, you have the right to access your personal data, update or correct it via your account dashboard (/account), pause or delete your property listings, withdraw consent for analytics tracking, or request permanent account deletion.

sections.title: 9. Changes and contact
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date. For privacy-related inquiries, please reach out via our Contact page (/contact) or our official support email.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Welcome to Aqar Exit. By accessing our platform, creating an account, listing a property for contract assignment, or submitting a purchase offer, you agree to comply with these Terms & Conditions designed to protect both sellers and buyers.

sections.title: 1. Platform Scope & Zero-Overprice Rule
sections.body: Aqar Exit operates as a verified digital marketplace and brokerage facilitator for installment property contract assignments at original contract prices. Our core rule prohibits any markup (overprice) above the actual amount paid to the developer: sellers recover their paid cash (or less if they offer a discount for a fast sale), while buyers take over the original contract price and continue remaining installments.

sections.title: 2. Direct Principals Only (No Brokers)
sections.body: Our platform is strictly for direct unit owners and end buyers. Real estate brokers, agents, or intermediaries are prohibited from listing properties they do not personally own or submitting offers on behalf of third parties to charge external commissions. Violating accounts and listings are permanently removed.

sections.title: 3. Document Verification & Financial Accuracy
sections.body: Sellers warrant that all submitted financial figures (total contract price, paid amount, remaining installments, and any overdue balances) are accurate. No unit is published to the public marketplace until at least one photo and the 4 mandatory verification documents (original purchase contract, payment receipts, developer account statement, and passport copy) are uploaded and verified by our team.

sections.title: 4. Purchase Offers, Negotiation & Priority Waitlist
sections.body: All purchase offers are reviewed by our deal advisors before being forwarded to sellers. To prevent spam, buyers may hold a maximum of three (3) active offers simultaneously. When a seller marks a unit as negotiable, their minimum acceptable floor remains strictly confidential with Admin. Once an offer is accepted, the unit enters "Under Contract" status and other offers are placed on the Priority Waitlist in case the transaction does not close.

sections.title: 5. Commission & Fee Structure (0% Seller Fee)
sections.body: Listing and assigning a unit through Aqar Exit is 100% free for sellers (0% seller commission). Buyers pay a 1.25% platform commission (calculated on the total original contract price), payable strictly upon successful completion of the official contract transfer at the developer's office.

sections.title: 6. Official Contract Assignment & Liability Disclaimer
sections.body: All contract transfers and cash settlements take place officially at the developer's headquarters and/or the National Agency of Public Registry (NAPR). Aqar Exit facilitates document verification, matching, negotiation, and transfer coordination, and is not liable for pre-existing contractual disputes with developers or construction delays.

sections.title: 7. Listing Boost Packages (+VIP & SUPER VIP)
sections.body: Sellers may purchase optional promotional boost packages to feature their units at the top of the marketplace. Boosts activate upon Admin approval of the listing and payment confirmation. If a listing cannot be approved due to document issues, any unspent boost payment is 100% refundable.

sections.title: 8. Pausing, Deleting Listings & Account Closure
sections.body: Owners may pause or delete their listings or request account deletion at any time prior to locking an accepted deal. Submitting an account deletion request immediately closes and withdraws all associated units and pending offers from the public market.

sections.title: 9. Governing Law & Contact
sections.body: These Terms & Conditions are governed by applicable laws in Georgia. For legal or operational inquiries, please contact us via our Contact page (/contact) or official support email.

faq.title: Everything You Need to Know About Zero-Overprice Exits
faq.subtitle: Clear, direct answers on how to recover your paid installments as a seller or take over an original developer contract as a buyer.

items.q: How is Aqar Exit different from traditional resale websites?
items.a: In traditional resale, sellers and brokers add an inflated markup (overprice) and figures are unverified. On Aqar Exit, overprice is strictly prohibited: the required cash is the exact receipt-verified amount paid to the developer (or less if the owner offers a discount for a quick exit), and every contract is verified before publication.

items.q: Do you accept listings or requests from real estate brokers?
items.a: No. We deal exclusively with the actual unit owner and the end buyer under the supervision of our deal advisors to ensure zero external brokerage markups.

items.q: Why assign my contract via Aqar Exit instead of cancelling with the developer?
items.a: Cancelling with a developer typically triggers a 10%–15% penalty calculated on the entire contract price (not just what you paid), which can wipe out 50%–75% of your paid cash, with the remainder refunded over several years. Assigning via Aqar Exit lets you recover up to 100% of your paid cash immediately upon transfer.

items.q: How much commission does the seller pay?
items.a: Zero (0%). Listing, verification, buyer matching, and transfer coordination are 100% free for the unit owner.

items.q: Is my phone number or name visible to the public on my listing?
items.a: No. Your contact details and uploaded documents are kept private and visible only to platform administration. Our deal advisor contacts you only when a serious, verified purchase offer is submitted.

items.q: What documents are required to publish my unit?
items.a: To verify your figures and grant the "Docs Verified" badge, we require at least 1 property photo and 4 documents: original purchase contract, payment receipts, developer account statement, and passport copy. You can save your unit draft first and upload documents anytime from My Account.

items.q: What is my advantage as a buyer taking over an installment contract?
items.a: You acquire the property at its old contract price—significantly below the developer's current price today—pay only the previously paid cash portion, and continue the remaining installments directly with the developer with zero overprice.

items.q: How does negotiation work on negotiable units?
items.a: If a seller has enabled "Negotiable", you can select "Submit Negotiated Offer" and enter the maximum cash amount you can pay. Our deal advisor will coordinate with the owner to reach the best agreement while keeping the owner's minimum floor strictly confidential.

items.q: What does "Under Contract" mean and how does the Priority Waitlist work?
items.a: When an owner accepts an offer, the unit is locked as "Under Contract" while transfer paperwork is finalized. Other interested buyers can click "Register Interest (In Case Deal Falls Through)" for free. If the primary deal does not close, waitlist buyers are notified immediately to confirm priority acquisition.

items.q: When is the 1.25% buyer commission paid?
items.a: The 1.25% buyer fee (calculated on total contract price) is paid only when the official contract assignment is completed at the developer's office. There are no upfront fees to submit offers.

items.q: Where and how does the cash payment and contract transfer happen?
items.a: All payments and contract transfers happen officially at the developer's headquarters and/or the Public Registry (NAPR) in the presence of your Aqar Exit case manager, via certified bank check or instant bank transfer upon signing.

storyPage.heroTitle: Why should anyone lose a huge portion of their money just because they can't continue installments?
storyPage.heroDescription: That question sparked the idea: building a clearer, more humane real estate market that helps you make decisions without pressure or ambiguity, preserving the value of every pound you paid.
storyPage.introP1: It started with a simple observation: many people enter real estate projects with a big dream, but life circumstances sometimes change before that dream is completed.
storyPage.introP2: Delays, new financial commitments, or a sudden need for liquidity. At that moment, the only option is often selling at a heavy loss or waiting endlessly.
storyPage.quote1: How can we exit our installments without losing money? And how do we ensure the contract and transfer process are crystal clear?
storyPage.sec1P1: The problem isn't the property itself — it's the lack of a fair exit path. The buyer needs a clear opportunity, and the seller needs to exit their commitment without losing what they paid.
storyPage.sec1P2: That's why we built a workflow that connects both sides and makes every step transparent.
storyPage.sec1SubTitle: Why not protect the interests of both parties?
storyPage.sec1Card1: The contract owner exits their commitment and recovers 100% of what they paid
storyPage.sec1Card2: And the buyer enters an opportunity at the original contract price with verified data
storyPage.sec2Title: And Thus Aqar Exit Was Born
storyPage.sec2Desc: A platform designed to make buying and selling installment units a clear process — not a race of empty promises or guesswork.
points: You know the exact amount you will receive
Verified numbers and a clear decision
Full respect for everyone's time and effort
storyPage.sec3Title: The Most Important Decision We Made From Day One
storyPage.sec3Desc: We started with a simple question: Can we be fair to both the seller and the buyer at the same time?
storyPage.quote2: We committed ourselves to facilitating transparent exits — never profiting from a unit owner's distress.
storyPage.zeroDesc: Because a fair exit shouldn't cost you extra commission, nor should you pay to recover your own money.
storyPage.sec4Title: For Me... True Value Isn't Just Selling a Unit
storyPage.sec4Desc: True value is exiting your financial commitment while understanding every number, starting your next chapter without regret or loss.
storyPage.quote3: When the decision is clear, all parties can move forward with peace of mind.
storyPage.sec5Title: Our Vision Goes Beyond a Property Listing Site
storyPage.sec5Desc: We are building a data-driven real estate community that respects people's time and opens fair opportunities across the market.
standards: Complete clarity in every step and figure
Fair evaluation based on actual contract documents
A secure platform protecting all parties' rights
storyPage.sec6Title: Ultimately... Aqar Exit is Built on One Idea
storyPage.quote4: A fair market is one where every party can walk away a winner.
storyPage.sec6Desc: The story is just beginning, and every unit owner we help is another step toward a more transparent market.
